openecraft-cli mcp

Runs a Model Context Protocol server on stdin / stdout: the tools of this list for AI agents, with the project kept in memory (save_project writes it, undo / redo revert single tool calls). OPENECRAFT_MCP_TOOLS limits the tools offered.
